title: AI diagnostics
intro: Development only. Not part of the game. The scenario below is test data.

status.title: Connection
status.unavailable: The diagnostics dev endpoint was not found (the API runs in production or without the diagnostics module).

run.title: Run
run.paidWarning: Auto with OpenAI enabled: this is a paid OpenAI request. The cost is charged to the diagnostics budget.
run.autoMockHint: OpenAI is disabled: mock will answer, the request is free.

result.title: Result
result.empty: Press “Test AI” to get a decision.
result.outOfList: The action is not in the local scenario list
result.costNote: estimate; the final OpenAI bill may differ

AI_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: AI is not configured
AI_NOT_CONFIGURED.hint: Choose the Mock provider or check apps/api/.env.

AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.title: Budget exhausted
AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.hint: The limit is shared by all diagnostic requests and does not reset by itself.

AI_RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests
AI_RATE_LIMITED.hint: There is no automatic retry — press the button later.

AI_TIMEOUT.title: OpenAI timeout
AI_TIMEOUT.hint: The game state was not changed.

AI_PROVIDER_ERROR.title: OpenAI API error
AI_PROVIDER_ERROR.hint: The game state was not changed.

AI_INVALID_DECISION.title: Invalid model answer
AI_INVALID_DECISION.hint: The action was rejected, nothing was executed.

AI_DEV_FORBIDDEN.title: Access denied
AI_DEV_FORBIDDEN.hint: Open the page on the machine where the API runs (localhost).
